content.text: Summary: Read T-3005, listed pods in `reporting`, and found two prior report-generator pods in Evicted/Failed state with kubelet messages showing ~38 GiB of ephemeral-storage usage and `request is 0`. Confirmed in the docs that the kubelet evicts pods on ephemeral-storage pressure and that this is controlled via `ephemeral-storage` requests/limits. Resolved the ticket with the cause, evidence, and a concrete Deployment fix (add `ephemeral-storage` request/limit, or move scratch data to a PV).
